questions.q: Where did Aminah die on the way back from Yathrib?
questions.explain: Aminah fell ill and died at Al-Abwa' while the Prophet SAW was with her.

questions.q: How did Abdul Muttalib treat the young Prophet SAW?
options: He defended him on his special seat and spoke of his bright future
He told him to sit outside
questions.explain: Give children room and encouraging words.

questions.q: Why did Abdul Muttalib choose Abu Talib as the Prophet's guardian rather than the richer Al-Abbas or Abu Lahab?
options: Because Abu Talib was the richest
Because Abu Talib was the oldest
Because Abu Talib had no children
Because of his character and ability to bring up a child
questions.explain: Character matters more than finances when choosing a child's guardian.

questions.q: Who was the Prophet's SAW second mother in Abu Talib's family?
questions.explain: Fatimah bint Asad was among the earliest women to embrace Islam and migrate.

questions.q: According to the Quranic definition, who counts as an orphan (yatim)?
options: A child who lost his father before puberty
A child who lost only his mother
questions.explain: Losing only a mother is not yatim in the Quranic sense, and after puberty one is no longer yatim.

questions.q: What did the Prophet's SAW orphanhood train in him?
options: Relying on no one, not even Allah
Relying on Allah alone, not on people
questions.explain: The wisdom of orphanhood trained the highest reliance on Allah.

questions.q: Are orphans among the zakat recipients (asnaf)?
questions.explain: An orphan is not a zakat recipient unless poor. Be careful with orphans' names and wealth.

questions.q: Losing only a mother makes a child an orphan (yatim) in the Quranic sense.
questions.explain: False. A yatim lost his father; losing both is called yatim piatu.

questions.q: Caring for an orphan means eating and living with us, not merely sending money.
questions.explain: True. Care for orphans within your own home.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: To Yathrib, Aminah died, his grandfather cared for him, he was bequeathed to Abu Talib, then moved to his house.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A child who lost his father before puberty
A child who lost both parents
A child bonded to a caring, calming adult

questions.explain: Yatim lost the father, yatim piatu lost both parents, baligh is adulthood, and securely attached is bonded to a caregiver.

questions.q: You are caring for an orphan. What does he need most besides food and drink?
options: Affection and an adult he is attached to
questions.explain: Orphans need love, not just food and drink.
